data.description:
## Description

**What**: Run validate.sh --ci against the polyglot Python+JS fixture, assert emitted stack array exactly matches the SC1 set, confirm both runners report separately. Append the pre-cutover review checklist to the final commit's PR body for the deep-tier reviewer.
**Why**: A single end-to-end exercise validates the schema, parser, consumers, auto-migration, and commands.* iteration in concert.
**Scope**:
- IN: Polyglot smoke-run script invoking validate.sh --ci; stack array exact-set assertion (per SC1); both-runner-report assertion; PR-body checklist (audit clean, fixture tests green, round-trip tests green, smoke green, inventory 100%, polyglot fixture executes both runners).
- OUT: Mixed-state partial-deploy CI cache invalidation (release-notes only, OUT per epic).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, validate.sh --ci against the polyglot fixture asserts the exact SC1 array set and both runners report separately ← Satisfies: SC1, SC3
- When complete, the final commit's PR body contains the pre-cutover review checklist ← Satisfies: epic In Scope final bullet
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Smoke run depends on every prior story landing; sequence as final story
- [Testing] Exact-set assertion (not subset) — order-canonicalize first

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, an end-to-end polyglot smoke run plus pre-cutover review checklist exits A0 cleanly
